verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented way to assign a conversation to a teammate or to route incoming mail to an owner. The nearby features are different capabilities. @mention in team comments shares an email with a teammate but does not assign ownership. AI filters and Splits label, star, archive and sort mail within your own inbox but do not route it to teammates. Triggers can add team comments, which is also not assignment.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit
